naming_notes: Patrick Ewing under 'Oklahoma City Thunder' (appears in 3 statements): he played for the Seattle SuperSonics (2000-01), the franchise that relocated to become the Thunder in 2008 — franchise-correct but never wore a Thunder uniform.

Washington Nationals statements include Pedro Martinez, Pete Rose, and Randy Johnson, all of whom played only for the Montreal Expos era of the franchise (pre-2005 relocation) — franchise-correct, never played as Nationals.
Warren Moon under 'Tennessee Titans': he played for the Houston Oilers era of the franchise, never as the Titans.
Los Angeles Chargers statement: Drew Brees, Johnny Unitas (1973), and Junior Seau were all San Diego-era Chargers — franchise-correct.

Las Vegas Raiders statements: Jerry Rice, Randy Moss, Marshawn Lynch, and Charles Woodson were Oakland-era; Eric Dickerson and Ronnie Lott were Los Angeles-era — all franchise-correct, none played in Las Vegas.
Deion Sanders under 'Washington Commanders': he played for the franchise in 2000 when it was the Washington Redskins — franchise-correct.
Kurt Warner under 'Los Angeles Rams': he played for the St. Louis-era Rams (as did Jerome Bettis in 1995, though Bettis was also LA 1993-94) — franchise-correct.
Cy Young under 'Boston Red Sox': he pitched for the franchise 1901-1908, mostly when it was named the Boston Americans (renamed Red Sox in 1908) — franchise-correct.
Category-design observation (not a factual error): in 'Name Is Also a Object', Billie Jean King's 'King' fits only loosely (a chess piece); Rice, Stone, and Woods fit more cleanly.
